properties.name: Valley Lakes Trail
properties.description: Main gravel road into the property — any vehicle. Scenic and hilly with stretches around the two lakes.
properties.cj_note: Hilly and long, but it's the main road so anything drives it fine. Beautiful views as you enter The Falls and circle the lakes. Keep an eye out for deer in the grasses, plus geese, ducks, turkey — even the occasional bobcat.

properties.name: Ridge Cabin Rd
properties.description: The short cabin spur. All five cabins sit on it with parking. Any vehicle.

properties.name: Coyote Canyon
properties.description: Long, mostly-flat trail that connects most of the rest of the network. Passes two ponds (not yet mapped).
properties.cj_note: Gets muddy in spots after rain.

properties.name: Lions View Way
properties.description: Climbs out of Coyote Canyon to the top of the ridge, then runs mostly flat with stellar views.
properties.cj_note: The climb up isn't bad. Some muddy spots after rain. Borderline easy/moderate.

properties.name: Cabin Connector
properties.description: Steep but short connector from the cabins down to Lions View Way.
properties.cj_note: Short enough that it's not bad — but slippery after rain.

properties.name: The 13 Connector
properties.description: Long flat trail connecting the main property to The 13. Gravel underfoot, so mud isn't bad — but fallen leaves can make it slick after rain.
properties.cj_note: Once you reach The 13, the trails get a little more interesting — but nothing crazy.

properties.name: Bobcat Pass
properties.description: Long ridgetop trail through nature-filled greenery. Beautiful walk.
properties.cj_note: Wear pants in spring/summer — gets a bit overgrown.

properties.name: Sasquatch Trail
properties.description: Fun route from the cabins to the lakes — woods, dam crossing, grassy hill overlooking the main lake, eventually meeting The 13 Connector. A little bit of everything.
properties.cj_note: Some steep climbs — leans toward hard in spots.

properties.name: Horse Pasture Trail
properties.description: Along the woodline of the horse pasture, out into the open field where the horses roam, and around to the small pond by Bates Farm Barn.
properties.cj_note: Rocky in spots. The hills back have some climb. Leans toward hard.

properties.name: Waterfall Loop
properties.description: Short but tough — steep down, steep back up. Best right after a rain when the small seasonal waterfall is actually running.
properties.cj_note: The waterfall is on the small side and only flows after rain — not really the namesake "Falls" of the property. My dad named it.

properties.name: The 13 Pavilion Hill
properties.description: Steep, short hill down to The 13 pavilion.

properties.name: Treehouse Hill
properties.description: Short, steep hill to the treehouse. Worth it for the views over The 13.

properties.name: Dam Trail
properties.description: Rocky hill down to The 13 dam.

properties.name: Dock Trail
properties.description: Easy trail tying everything together at The 13.

properties.name: Nature Barn Hill
properties.description: Short but steep gravel hill.

properties.name: Bobcat Connector
properties.description: The hardest trail on the property — steep, rocky, overgrown in spots, muddy in others. A shortcut if you're up for it.
properties.cj_note: Not for the faint of heart. If you'd rather avoid it, take Bobcat Pass to Coyote Canyon around instead.

properties.name: Buck Bottom
properties.description: One of CJ's favorites — peaceful walk through the bottom of the valley. Green canopy overhead, tranquil vibe.
properties.cj_note: Small hill at the end where it connects to Coyote Canyon. Borderline easy/moderate.

properties.name: Camp Trail
properties.description: Flat trail through the camp area. Gets overgrown and muddy in spots — for those up for an adventure.
properties.cj_note: Brushhog is on the to-do list. Until then it's a proper forest walk.

properties.name: Shooting Shack Loop
properties.description: Short loop out to the shooting shack with parking.

properties.name: Lake Pavilion Loop
properties.description: Short loop down to the lake pavilion. Big Lou (the bear carving) is on this loop.

properties.name: Pavilion Spur
properties.description: Tiny flat spur connecting Lake Pavilion Loop to Sasquatch Trail.

properties.name: Lefarth Dr
properties.description: Gravel access road from Lions Den Rd to the property gate — the correct way in. Don't trust GPS routes via Sunny Creek.
properties.cj_note: Please don't walk this — it's a road through residential property. Stopping briefly to look at the horses is fine.
